title: Your circuits
lead: Every circuit saved to your account, newest first.

empty.heading: Nothing saved yet
empty.body: Build a circuit in the editor and save it. It will be listed here, with every version you keep.
empty.pastTheEnd: There is nothing on this page. The listing may have grown shorter since this link was made.

document.offline: You are offline, so this circuit has not been asked for yet. It will open as soon as the connection is back.

save.heading: Save
save.nothingToSave: Nothing has changed since the last save.
save.ownershipLost: This circuit is not yours to add to. You can keep your work as a circuit of your own instead.

status.anonymous: Not saved to an account. This circuit travels in the page address, exactly as it did before you signed up — sign in and it can have a home.
status.unsaved: Not saved yet. The circuit is held in this page's address until you save it.
status.dirty: Edited since version {{version}}. The change is held in this page's address until you save it.
status.uncarried: Edited since version {{version}}. This circuit is too large to fit in the page address, so the change exists only in this tab — save it before you close the page.

visibility.label: Who can open it
visibility.UNLISTED: Anyone holding the link. It appears in no listing.
visibility.PUBLIC: Anyone, and it appears in the gallery.

message.label: What changed (optional)
message.hint: A short note, kept with this version in the history.

conflict.body: Somebody saved while you were editing. You started from version {{base}} and the newest is now version {{server}}, which you have not seen.
conflict.saveAnyway: Save mine on top, keeping both
conflict.discardMine: Discard my changes and open version {{version}}
conflict.raced: Your work was saved as version {{landed}}. Version {{other}} arrived a moment earlier and you have not seen it — nothing was lost, and both are in the history.

history.heading: History
history.hint: Every save is a version of its own. Nothing here is ever rewritten or removed.
history.noMessage: No note was left with this version.
history.compareWithPrevious: Compare with the version before it
history.backToDocument: Back to the circuit you are editing
history.notLive: This is a past version, kept exactly as it was saved. It cannot be edited, and the circuit you were working on is untouched.

restore.explain: Restoring saves version {{number}}'s circuit again, as a new version. Version {{number}} stays exactly where it is, and so does everything after it.
restore.cancel: Leave the history as it is
restore.alreadyHere: This is already the circuit you have open, saved as version {{number}}. There is nothing to bring back.
restore.dirtyWarning: You have edits that are not saved. Restoring replaces what is on the canvas with this version, and those edits are not part of it.
restore.done: Version {{number}} is back. It was saved as version {{landed}}, so the history now runs up to {{landed}} and nothing in it was rewritten or removed.
restore.stale: Somebody saved while you were reading. The newest is now version {{server}}, which you have not seen. Restoring version {{number}} lands after it and loses nothing — both stay in the history.

message.label: Note for the new version
message.hint: Kept with the version this restore creates, so the history says what happened.

history.compareUnavailable: The version you asked to compare against could not be opened, so only the version below is shown.
history.versionUnavailable: That version does not exist, or it is not shared with you.

diff.heading: What changed between version {{from}} and version {{to}}
diff.identical: These two versions hold the same circuit.
diff.tooManyColumns: The diagram draws the first {{drawn}} columns. The {{hidden}} past that are in both documents but not in this picture.

aspect.order: the wires in a different order

register.qubits: The register went from {{before}} to {{after}} qubits.
register.clbits: The classical register went from {{before}} to {{after}} bits.
register.labels: At least one wire was renamed.

document.parameters: A named parameter was added, removed or retuned.
document.customGates: A reusable subcircuit was added, removed or redefined.

offline: You are offline, so this has not been asked for yet. It will load as soon as the connection is back.
